en.description:
WristX Games brings 50+ games to your Apple Watch: fast arcade runs, brain-teasing puzzles, classic board and card games against a smart AI, carrom, and party games to pass around the table. Every game is built for the wrist, with big touch targets, the Digital Crown and quick rounds, and every game plays offline.

Download free and play Dice, Coin Flip, Snake, 2048, Tic Tac Toe, Pong, Memory Match and Stack Tower as much as you like. Every other game can be played three times free on each device. WristX VIP unlocks all 50+ games on your Apple Watch and iPhone, plus every new game we add. No ads, ever.

NEW: 14 GAMES
Pinball, Solitaire, Carrom, Hill Buggy, Bubble Shooter, Loop, GK Quiz, Easy Tambola, Dumb Charades, Yacht, Gomoku, Safe Crack, Whack-a-Mole and Zig Zag.

ARCADE
Flip the Pinball table, drive Hill Buggy over endless hills with the crown as your throttle, aim and fire in Bubble Shooter, feel for the combination in Safe Crack, bonk the moles in Whack-a-Mole and turn at every corner in Zig Zag. Race an auto-rickshaw through the city in Rickshaw Rush, fly a magic carpet in Sky Carpet, defend the galaxy in Astro Blaster, smash bricks in Brick Blitz and build sky-high in Stack Tower. Plus Jet Drift, Snake, Pong, Orbit, Tilt Maze, Kineti Run and Car Racing.

PUZZLE
Solitaire (Klondike, one- or three-card draw), Loop, Mines, Mini Sudoku, Word Guess, Block Puzzle, Slide 15, Light Flip, Memory Match, 2048 and Echo.

BOARD
Chess, Ludo, Gomoku, Yacht, Tic Tac Toe, Four in a Row, Reversi, Dots & Boxes, Checkers and Mancala. Play the AI at three levels, or a friend on the same watch.

SPORTS
Carrom: slide the striker along your baseline, aim with a drag or the crown, hold to charge and let go. Pocket your coins and cover the queen, on a quick board or the full nineteen coins, against the AI or a friend passing the watch.

PARTY
Easy Tambola: the watch calls 1 to 90 for the whole table, with an auto-call pace and a prize checklist, or dab a ticket while someone else calls. Dumb Charades: act out the film, the song or the everyday thing for your team. GK Quiz, Bollywood Quiz, Truth or Dare, Snakes & Ladders, Fleet Hunt, Hand Cricket and Chidiya Udd. Pass the watch around!

TOOLS
Dice and a coin for board-game night.

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
The same Mines, Mini Sudoku, Slide 15, Loop and Word Guess puzzle, Solitaire deal, GK ten and Hill Buggy road for everyone in the world each day, with a leaderboard for today.

MADE FOR THE WATCH
• Games fill the whole screen, with your score right beside the clock
• The Digital Crown steers, aims, flips and rolls; Safe Crack and Echo are played by feel
• A quick hint shows how to play each game, then gets out of the way
• One tap to play, and your best score on every game
• Pick up an unfinished game right where you left it
• Sound and vibration you can turn off

THE IPHONE APP
• Browse every game and see how to play it
• Game Center leaderboards for today, this week and all time
• Your best scores and records from your watch
• Daily puzzles with today's top players
• Send a game to your watch, or play a practice round on iPhone
• Light, dark or system appearance

Leaderboards count games played on Apple Watch, so the rankings stay fair. Every game also plays on iPhone for practice.

WRISTX VIP
• Lifetime: one payment, every game for good
• Yearly: 7-day free trial, then billed yearly
• Monthly: billed monthly, cancel anytime
One plan covers the Apple Watch app and the iPhone app. Yearly and Monthly renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in Settings › your name › Subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Everyone who installed WristX Games before version 1.3 keeps every game.

Terms of Use: https://www.ashishbaghel.com/terms-wg.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.ashishbaghel.com/privacy-wg.html

Requires Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later for the watch games.

zh.description:
Wrist Games puts a whole arcade on your Apple Watch: 35+ games and handy tools, built for the small screen, the Digital Crown and quick moments. Pay once and get everything, with every future update. No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, and it works fully offline.

ARCADE
• Rickshaw Rush: race an auto-rickshaw through the city from day to night, jumping cows, cones and potholes
• Sky Carpet: fly a magic carpet over the desert, dodge daggers and banish the Sand Djinn
• Astro Blaster: hold the line against diving alien formations and their mothership
• Brick Blitz: a neon brick breaker with lasers, multi-ball, fireballs and eight levels
• Stack Tower, Tilt Maze (steer the ball by tilting your wrist), Jet Drift, Car Racing, Kineti Run, Snake, Orbit and paddle tennis

PUZZLE
• Word Guess: find the five-letter word, typing on a ring of letters with your finger or the crown
• Mini Sudoku, Mines, Block Puzzle, Slide 15, Light Flip, Memory Match, Echo and 2048
• Daily puzzles: the same Sudoku, Mines, Slide and word for everyone, every day

BOARD
• Chess with three AI levels, Ludo, Four in a Row, Reversi, Checkers, Dots & Boxes, Mancala and Tic Tac Toe
• Play against the AI on Easy, Medium or Hard, or pass the watch to a friend

PARTY
• Bollywood Quiz: nearly 3,000 questions about Hindi films, their stars, directors and music, solo or as a two-player duel
• Truth or Dare for 2 to 8 players, with family-friendly cards
• Snakes & Ladders, Fleet Hunt (sink the hidden fleet), Hand Cricket and Chidiya Udd

TOOLS
• Dice: roll 1 to 6 dice for any board game on the table, with your last five rolls on screen
• Coin Flip: a spinning coin toss with a running heads-and-tails count

MADE FOR THE WATCH
• Every game is designed for the small screen and the Digital Crown
• Haptic feedback you can feel
• Best scores, best times and win–loss records for each AI level
• Pick up where you left off: games save automatically when you lower your wrist
• Your recent games are always at the top of the list

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Wrist Games collects no data at all. There's no sign-in, no ads and no analytics; your scores and saved games stay on your watch.

Requires Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later.
